name: Barbecue Brisket

instructions.primary_message: Trim brisket of hard and excess fat, leaving 0.5-cm layer of fat along top. Coat brisket liberally in your favorite dry rub and wrap in heavy duty aluminum foil. Place in refrigerator and let it sit for 8 hours and up to one day.
Fire up your smoker between 102°C to 107°C (100°C-110°C). Add chunks of wood, and when they begin to smoke, remove brisket from foil and place in smoker.

Cook brisket between 102°C to 107°C (100°C-110°C) until an instant read thermometer reads 74°C in flat section of brisket, 10 to 12 hours. Wrap brisket in heavy duty aluminum foil and put back into smoker. Continue cooking until point section of brisket registers 90°C, 4 to 6 hours more. Remove from smoker, let rest at least 30 minutes, slice and serve.

description: This brisket is smoked long-and-low for perfect, meltingly-tender results.
notes: Total time, including resting: 1 day 3 hr 10 min.
author: Joshua Bousel
